title: Current Policies Only
briefMd:
# Phase 6 · Current Policies Only

The policy wiki never deletes anything. Every policy keeps its old versions, and some have an unapproved draft for next year. They read almost the same: only the number that changed differs. Staff get answers from 2024, or from a draft that was never approved.

Every document carries metadata: `family` (which policy), `version`, `status` (`current`, `superseded` or `draft`) and `effective` date. The Corpus tab shows it.

You control a **status filter** (`none`, `exclude-superseded`, `current-only`), **where it runs** (`pre`: filter the index, then take the top k; `post`: take the top k, then drop what fails the filter) and **topK**. Retrieval is BM25 over whole documents, and every chunk that survives the filter is sent to the model.

A question counts as stale when its context also holds another version of the same policy: two numbers that disagree.

**Gates:** recall@k ≥ 0.90, stale context rate ≤ 0.05, and mean prompt tokens ≤ 120 on the hidden set.

statusFilter.description: Which documents may reach the context, by their status metadata.

filterStage.description: pre filters the index before top-k; post drops failing chunks after top-k.
